languageModelTools.name: shuncode_list_directory
languageModelTools.modelDescription: List one or two levels of a known workspace directory. Prefer this over recursive file search when you simply need to see what a directory contains. With ShunCode Bridge MCP, call Bridge set_todos (or Bridge update_plan) before other tools: new_task=true for new work, acknowledged task_id/revision only for the same unfinished job. Ended cards are sealed; blocked/interrupted cards may only update existing steps. A client-local plan or report_progress is not durable; send a completed/blocked snapshot before the final answer. If both writers fail, continue without repeated task-card retries and say the ShunCode task card was not synchronized; never claim unacknowledged updates. All task-card titles, steps, phase labels, progress updates and explanations shown to users must use Simplified Chinese; keep protocol names/enums English.
languageModelTools.userDescription: List the contents of a workspace directory.

languageModelTools.name: shuncode_run_command
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Run native bash source directly in a ShunCode-managed independent Bash PTY on Linux, macOS and Windows, not the user's configured terminal profile; do not add a bash -lc wrapper around ordinary commands. Do not infer PowerShell, CMD or zsh from the host OS. On macOS /bin/bash is 3.2; Windows uses product-bundled PortableGit Bash. Idle owner-scoped terminals with the same cwd are reused and close automatically after two hours; concurrent or busy commands may use additional terminals. background defaults to false; use true only for long-running servers/watchers. Commands require user confirmation when invoked from Chat. With ShunCode Bridge MCP, call Bridge set_todos (or Bridge update_plan) before other tools: new_task=true for new work, acknowledged task_id/revision only for the same unfinished job. Ended cards are sealed; blocked/interrupted cards may only update existing steps. A client-local plan or report_progress is not durable; send a completed/blocked snapshot before the final answer. If both writers fail, continue without repeated task-card retries and say the ShunCode task card was not synchronized; never claim unacknowledged updates. All task-card titles, steps, phase labels, progress updates and explanations shown to users must use Simplified Chinese; keep protocol names/enums English.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Run a command in a ShunCode-managed integrated terminal.

languageModelTools.name: shuncode_get_command_output
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Read incremental output and status from a command previously started by ShunCode. Pass only the exact opaque cmd_... command_id token, not terminal_id or adjacent output lines.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Read output from a running or completed ShunCode command.

languageModelTools.name: shuncode_cancel_command
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Cancel a managed command by its random owner-scoped command_id capability. Default behavior is soft interrupt only and never auto-forces. If force_required=true, force=true requires host-owned local confirmation and can close only that managed PTY; protected packaging, signing, install, migration, archive/restore, and bulk-move operations cannot be force-cancelled. Idempotent on final states; do not send Ctrl+C as interactive text.

languageModelTools.name: shuncode_send_command_input
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Send input to a running ShunCode integrated terminal command. Pass only the exact opaque cmd_... command_id token, not terminal_id or adjacent output lines.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Send text to a running ShunCode command.

languageModelTools.name: shuncode_get_diagnostics
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Read current diagnostics from VS Code and active language services for the workspace or a scoped file/directory.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Read current editor and language-service diagnostics.

languageModelTools.name: shuncode_lsp
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Navigate code semantically using the language services already active in VS Code. Use for workspace/document symbols, definitions, references, implementations, and hover/type information. Results include provider_state, project_anchor, project_anchor_source, warmup_performed, and semantic_result_inconclusive metadata so empty semantic results and heuristic warm-up anchors are not over-interpreted. project_anchor_source=warmup_candidate means the anchor is only a project-activation hint, not proof that the symbol was found there. Prefer this for code symbols; use search_files for raw text and read_files for implementation details after locating the symbol.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Navigate definitions, references, symbols, implementations, and hover information through active language services.

path.description: Workspace source path. Workspace-relative is preferred; absolute paths are accepted only when they remain inside the workspace. For workspace_symbols this is optional and may be a project/file/directory anchor.

languageModelTools.name: shuncode_wait
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Block for a fixed amount of time, then return. Use to let a background command (run_command with background=true) make progress before reading its output with get_command_output, or to give a server/watcher time to emit more output. Choose one wait long enough for the expected work (e.g. 10-30 seconds for builds, up to 120 seconds for slow compiles) instead of polling get_command_output in a tight loop. The wait only sleeps; it does not check command status.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Wait a fixed amount of time.

shuncode.model.baseUrl.description: OpenAI Chat Completions-compatible base URL used by ShunCode.

shuncode.model.name.description: Model identifier exposed in the native Chat model picker and used by the ShunCode Agent Runtime.

shuncode.chat.bridgeStyleUI.description: Render ShunCode Chat tool activity with the compact Bridge-inspired card style. This setting does not change Bridge mode.

shuncode.chat.sharedHistory.description: Synchronize native local chat history across all ShunCode windows and instances on this PC through the shared workspace hub. Shared records are read-only outside their owning workspace. Original workspace history is retained as a compatibility backup.

shuncode.runtime.entryPoint.description: Optional absolute path to dist/src/agent-host.js. The ShunCode carrier normally injects this automatically.

shuncode.bridge.ngrokDomain.description: Reserved ngrok HTTPS hostname used by the ShunCode Streamable HTTP MCP Bridge, for example your-name.ngrok-free.dev.

shuncode.bridge.customInstructions.description: Optional custom text appended to the Bridge MCP server instructions (the system prompt remote agents receive on connect). Leave empty to send only the built-in instructions. Applies to the next remote connection; use \n for line breaks.

shuncode.bridge.ngrokUseHttpProxy.description: Let the ngrok tunnel process use the resolved VS Code/system HTTP proxy. Requires an ngrok Pay-as-you-go plan; ngrok Free rejects HTTP proxies with ERR_NGROK_9009. Keep this off to run ngrok in direct connection mode.

enumDescriptions: Connect directly first; if no Cloudflare edge connection registers and an HTTP proxy is configured (http.proxy or the system proxy), carry the Quick Tunnel through that proxy.
Always connect to the Cloudflare edge directly (QUIC, falling back to HTTP/2).
Always carry the Quick Tunnel through the HTTP proxy (HTTP/2 over CONNECT to port 7844).
shuncode.bridge.cloudflareEdgeRoute.markdownDescription: How the Cloudflare Quick Tunnel reaches the Cloudflare edge. cloudflared cannot use an HTTP proxy for this connection, so for the proxy route ShunCode runs a local relay that carries it through `http.proxy` or the system proxy with CONNECT; the proxy must allow CONNECT to port 7844. The Quick Tunnel always runs with its own cloudflared config, so `~/.cloudflared/config.yml` does not apply.

shuncode.bridge.cloudflareNamedDomain.description: Fixed HTTPS hostname configured as a Cloudflare Tunnel published application, for example mcp.example.com.

shuncode.bridge.cloudflareNamedLocalPort.description: Fixed localhost port used by Cloudflare Named Tunnel. Configure the Cloudflare published application Service URL as http://127.0.0.1:<port>.

enumDescriptions: Cloudflare Quick Tunnel. No account or domain required; the public URL changes after restart.
Cloudflare Named Tunnel. Stable hostname; requires a Cloudflare account, managed domain, Tunnel Token, and published application route.
ngrok reserved domain. Requires an ngrok account, Authtoken, and configured domain.
shuncode.bridge.tunnelProvider.description: Public tunnel provider used by ShunCode Bridge.

shuncode.bridge.persistentMode.description: Open ShunCode in Bridge mode and start the Bridge automatically after the Chat view has finished rendering.

enumDescriptions: Project files. Prefer the currently open ShunCode workspace and only inspect another local path when the user explicitly identifies it.
Entire device. Allow the same local Windows device by default while still prioritizing the currently open ShunCode workspace.
shuncode.bridge.workspaceScope.description: Default operating scope described to remote Bridge agents. Workspace file tools remain workspace-scoped; outside-workspace paths use run_command.

shuncode.mcp.extraCaCertificates.markdownDescription: Optional PEM file with additional root certificates for shared stdio MCP servers (passed as `NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS`, appended to the built-in list). A path, not a secret; leave empty to use the system certificates.

shuncode.bridge.startupTimeoutMs.description: Maximum time to wait for the public Bridge health endpoint after the tunnel reports readiness. Deterministic network failures (DNS or connection refused) abort startup earlier regardless of this limit.

shuncode.bridge.copyPromptText.markdownDescription: Text the Bridge page's **Copy prompt** button places after the MCP address. The address is always taken from the running Bridge and is never read from this setting, so editing it cannot produce a stale or wrong endpoint. Leave empty to use the built-in default.

shuncode.bridge.startupPinPage.description: 每次重启软件或新建窗口时自动将 Bridge 设置页置顶并固定，替换默认欢迎页。关闭时恢复默认配置。
shuncode.bridge.startupPinPage.markdownDescription: Automatically pin and bring the Bridge settings page to the front on every software restart and new window, replacing the default welcome page. When disabled, the default startup configuration is restored.

shuncode.bridge.settingsPageFloating.description: 在窗口内的悬浮卡中独立显示 Bridge 设置，可拖动、不再平铺在设置页背景里。关闭时 Bridge 设置嵌入设置页（默认）。
shuncode.bridge.settingsPageFloating.markdownDescription: Render the Bridge settings in a draggable floating card inside the window instead of filling the embedded settings page. When disabled (default), the Bridge settings stay embedded in the settings page.

enumDescriptions: Restore only the last closed window on startup (default).
Restore all windows from the previous session on startup.
shuncode.windowRestore.description: How ShunCode restores windows on startup.

shuncode.bridge.quickLinks.description: Custom quick-open shortcuts shown as buttons at the top of the Bridge page. Each opens in the ShunCode built-in browser.

shuncode.bridge.toolConcurrency.markdownDescription: Initial Bridge tool concurrency (default 16). Adaptive concurrency grows under sustained healthy load up to 64 and backs off on errors or slow calls. Restart Bridge's extension host after changing this setting.

shuncode.bridge.skillsEnabled.markdownDescription: 加载全局和当前项目 Skill。关闭后不再作为 MCP 工具提供；不改变各 Skill 的全局启停状态，JSON 工具不受影响。可在 Bridge 下方的 Skill 页面管理。

shuncode.multiModel.enabled.description: Enable multi-model rounds. In Plan mode, different models answer the same question from the context before the previous round; the merge model reads all branches and, when necessary, performs read-only file verification, producing consensus, disagreements, and the final plan. Only adopted branches continue into subsequent context. When disabled, an empty input no longer triggers branch sending.

shuncode.multiModel.mergeModel.description: Merge model in vendor/modelId format. Leave empty to use the model selected in the current conversation when merging.

shuncode.multiModel.mergeReadTools.description: Allow the merge model to perform read-only file verification when merging. Files are read only when branches disagree or the conclusion lacks evidence.

shuncode.multiModel.maxBranches.description: Maximum number of branches per round. When the limit is reached, merge or adopt a branch before generating more branches for the same question.

shuncode.multiModel.mergeReasoningEffort.description: Thinking effort used by the merge model when summarizing branches. Only applies when shuncode.multiModel.mergeModel is set to a separate merge model; otherwise merging follows the thinking setting of the current conversation. If the merge model does not support the selected effort (DeepSeek supports low/high/max only; Codex models cannot disable thinking or use Ultra), the merge model default effort is used instead.

shuncode.terminal.pipelineExitCodes.description: Include pipeline_exit_codes (per-command Bash PIPESTATUS) in run_command and get_command_output responses.
